note: A review of 118 papers finds 53 uses of large language models in education, from grading to feedback, but flags low readiness, poor transparency and weak privacy safeguards, so it urges open sourcing, newer models and human centred design.
title: Practical and ethical challenges of large language models in education: A systematic scoping review
authors: Lixiang Yan, Lele Sha, Linxuan Zhao, Yuheng Li, Roberto Martínez‐Maldonado, Guanliang Chen, et al.
